title: Make Account and Administrator calmer
summary: Account and administrator tools now open from simple task-focused hubs, with personal preferences, roster management and technical system detail revealed only when needed.
changes: Account now opens to four clear destinations: Profile, Preferences, Security, and App & Help, instead of placing every setting and action in one long sheet.
Administrator now opens to Tonight, People & Access, Roster Management, and System, replacing the crowded five-tab control rail with a task-focused landing view.
Publishing and permanent team rotation are grouped behind Roster Management, while system health, recent admin activity, exports and diagnostics are grouped under System.
Technical health and audit detail stays collapsed until requested, while the existing roster, account, passkey, export and administrator actions continue to use their proven underlying logic.
